changelog:
landing-page-builder 1.0.0 initial release

- Generate single-page landing pages from text prompts or design briefs.
- Adapt user-provided HTML templates with new branding and content, preserving all styles and scripts.
- Output a ready-to-deploy, standalone .html file with no external dependencies except Google Fonts.
- Customizable by business name, description, audience, tone, and optional reference templates.
- Designed for mobile-first, accessible, fast, and conversion-focused landing pages.
